The conditions are:

\[
\frac{20n}{34}=\frac{10n}{17}\in\mathbb Z \implies 17\mid n
\]

\[
\frac{17n}{34}=\frac n2\in\mathbb Z \implies 2\mid n
\]

\[
\frac{(52/3)n}{34}=\frac{26n}{51}\in\mathbb Z \implies 51\mid n
\]

Thus \(n\) must be a multiple of \(\operatorname{lcm}(17,2,51)=102\). The smallest possible value is

\[
\boxed{102}
\]
